name: sop-manager
description: Create and find SOPs, audit library health, manage review queues, and report SOP analytics through one conversation.

interface.shortDescription: Manage a governed SOP library in Notion
interface.longDescription: Create evidence-grounded Core Process, SOP, Work Instruction, and Checklist drafts; retrieve only Approved SOPs; audit library health; prioritize human review queues; report current-state analytics; and submit missing-SOP requests using the official Notion connector.
defaultPrompt: Set up SOP Manager in my Notion workspace.
Audit my SOP library without changing anything.
Show me the SOPs that need review next.
